questions.answer: Yes, whenever I get the chance. I love being outdoors, whether it's a walk by the river or a short trip somewhere green. Being in nature is easily the best way for me to [[rejuvenate]].

questions.q: What outdoor activities are popular in your country?
questions.answer: Cricket is the obvious one, played in every field and alley. Apart from that, people enjoy fishing, boating on the rivers and family picnics, which are a [[cherished]] winter tradition here.

questions.q: Did you spend a lot of time outdoors as a child?
questions.answer: Almost constantly. My mother had a hard time getting me inside before dark. I was either playing cricket, climbing trees or wandering along the riverbank, so I was [[perpetually]] covered in mud when I finally came home.

questions.q: Do you prefer being indoors or outdoors?
questions.answer: Given the choice, outdoors, though the weather here decides a lot. In the height of summer the heat can be [[sweltering]], so I stay in, but on a cool winter morning nothing beats being outside.

questions.q: Do you think people spend less time outdoors than in the past?
questions.answer: Sadly, yes. Cities are more crowded, open spaces are disappearing, and screens keep people indoors. I think we're gradually becoming [[disconnected from]] nature, which probably affects our mood and health more than we realise.
